metadata.name: Mercy Ward
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A two-storey hospital at night, built from madduck's Modular 3D Hospital Environment: a concourse with the entrance lobby, waiting room and cafeteria off it, two four-bed wards and a back corridor downstairs; intensive care, the operating theatre with its glazed isolation room, and the landing upstairs. The main stairs climb from the concourse; fire escapes climb from the yards into the upstairs corridor. Co-op: raise the code-black alarm at reception, then clear the wards, intensive care and the theatre of the infected. Zombies: hold out on the wards.

objectives.text: Raise the code-black alarm at reception
Clear the operating theatre, upstairs east

do.text: Mercy Ward, the night shift. Something is wrong on the wards.
Code black! The patients are out of their beds.
The theatre doors just burst open...
All clear. Mercy Ward is quiet again.
